segments.name: Semiconductor Technologies
segments.description: Supplies consumable materials such as CMP pads, slurries, cleaning chemistries and lithographic materials used at multiple stages of semiconductor manufacturing.
segments.evidence: Our Semiconductor Technologies segment provides a portfolio of innovative materials and solutions utilized across multiple stages of the semiconductor manufacturing process.

segments.name: Interconnect Solutions
segments.description: Supplies materials for signal integrity, thermal and power management and advanced packaging used in circuit boards and semiconductor packaging.
segments.evidence: Our Interconnect Solutions segment offers what we believe to be a comprehensive range of best-in-class material solutions that address the evolving complexities of signal integrity, thermal and power management and advanced packaging.

revenueModel.text: Chipmakers, foundries, equipment providers and OEMs pay Qnity for consumable materials specified into their manufacturing processes.
revenueModel.evidence: we partner with original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") who specify our products into their manufacturing process
